description: This walk takes you along the coast path from St Helier to St Aubin. You can follow a shared cycling and walking path between the two settlements for about 3 miles. It's a nice, flat surfaced path with lovely views across St Aubin's Bay to enjoy. While the paved path is perfect for an easy stroll, many people choose to walk directly on the sand at low tide for a more scenic experience. Along the way, you’ll pass Elizabeth Castle, which sits on a rocky islet reachable by a tidal causeway, and various information boards detailing the bay's history as a major shipbuilding hub. A popular detour near Millbrook is St Matthew’s Glass Church, which features world-renowned glasswork by René Lalique.Once you reach the charming harbour at St Aubin, you are greeted by historic spots like the Old Court House Inn and plenty of seafood restaurants.You can continue your walking on theCorbiere Railway Walkwhich runs from St Aubin to the iconic La Corbiere Lighthouse.
